title: Vegan Stir Fry with Smoky Flair
description: A flavorful and healthy stir-fry dish made with smoky spices and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the light soy sauce and smoky paprika, and stir to combine.
Cook for a further minute, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve over brown rice and enjoy!
Optional: add some chopped nuts or seeds for extra crunch and texture.
